bodyHtml:
ROT-6 Reverse Osmosis Storage Tank

24-Liter (6.0 Gallon) High-Capacity Tank for Office & Large Family Kitchen Systems | Aquasky RO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

The ROT-6 is a high-capacity, 24L (6.0 gal) steel water storage tank for reverse osmosis systems, delivering safe, pressurized water for large groups. 

 

It has a maximum operating pressure of 7 bar (100 psi) and a temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). Factory pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to 0.5-0.7 bar (7-10 psi) for stable performance. 

 

Measuring 29.0 cm (11.4 in) in diameter and 39.3 cm (15.5 in) in height, this stand-model tank includes a reliable plastic base, offering a safe, energy-saving, and easy-to-install solution for high-demand settings.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-6 is a 24-liter (6.0 gallon) diaphragm pressure tank engineered for high-capacity Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems. Built with a durable steel shell, it is sized to supply clean water for up to 6 people, making it ideal for large families and busy offices. The system securely stores purified water and delivers it with robust pressure, ensuring high performance and energy savings. 

Perfect for residential and commercial use, the ROT-6 features a hygienic design that separates water from compressed gas and prevents contact with the steel shell. 

Utilizing an FDA-approved polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-compliant butyl diaphragm, it delivers fresh, tasteless water free of rubber or plastic odors. Manufactured with premium materials and holding NSF58, CE, and IAPMO certifications, Aquasky tanks ensure a long service life and the safest drinking water compatibility available.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Epoxy powder exterior paint for high protection against oxidation and fine finish.
  • Stainless-steel water connection: lead-free, chemical-free, patented leak-safe technology (Aquasky invention in 18 years).
  • High-performance butyl rubber diaphragm meets DIN 4807.
  • Internal virgin FDA-approved polypropylene liner prevents water-to-metal contact.
  • Patented leakage-free O-ring sealed air valve cap.
  • 100% factory pre-charged with nitrogen (not air).
  • 100% pressure tested before shipment for ultimate reliability.
  • High customization available for distinct market branding.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the RO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

ROT-6 stores supplemental water securely between the butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber maintains constant system pressure. When a drinking tap or coffee maker is activated, the compressed nitrogen pushes the purified water into the system at a controlled pressure.

This specialized design ensures stable performance, completely separates the water from the metal shell, and maintains a clean water zone that is completely free of rubber or plastic odors.

Key benefits

  • Delivers cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water by isolating the water supply from metals and plastics
  • Provides a tasteless water zone with absolutely no rubber or plastic smells
  • Guarantees zero air loss and exceptional air resistance, outperforming other tanks on the market
  • Completely maintenance-free during its entire expected service life

Typical Applications

  • High-capacity Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems
  • Office drinking water and filtration setups
  • Large family residential drinking water systems (suitable for up to 6 people)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Is the ROT- 6 safe for storing my drinking water?

Yes. The ROT-6 uses a high-grade polypropylene liner and a butyl diaphragm made with FDA-approved materials, which completely prevents the water from ever making contact with the steel tank shell. 

This guarantees a tasteless water zone with no rubber or plastic smells, making it perfectly safe for clean drinking water. Furthermore, the stainless steel connector is completely chemical-free and lead-free.

Q2 : Will the ROT-6 provide enough water for a large family kitchen?

Yes, the 24-liter (6.0-gallon) ROT-6 is engineered specifically for large family kitchens and office environments. It safely supports the drinking water needs of up to 6 people while offering excellent energy savings.

Q3 : What makes Aquasky RO tanks the industry standard?

AQUASKY invented the leak-safe technology applied to the stainless connector 18 years ago, setting the benchmark for drinking water tanks. Manufactured in an ISO 9001:2008 registered facility and holding top-tier certifications like NSF58 and CE, it is recognized as one of the safest pressure vessels in the market.
